decisions.statement: Neutral AuthPort and TenantContextPort contracts defined in packages/contracts/src/auth-port.ts, decoupled from browser or DOM dependencies.
PlatformAuthStorage abstraction enables neutral secure token storage across desktop web, mobile web, iOS, and Android.
PasswordResetResult explicitly exposes deliveryChannel to accommodate dev environments lacking SMTP.

actions: Created api-contracts.md detailing AuthPort, TenantContextPort, DTOs, Error Catalog, and PlatformAuthStorage boundary.

evidence.description: API and Port contracts specification for Auth and Tenant Context
